title: IDF Drone Strike on Displaced Persons Tent Camp Kills 6+ in Gaza City, Groom Among Dead
detail: An Israeli drone struck a tent sheltering displaced Palestinians in Gaza City on June 6, 2026, killing at least 6 and wounding 15 or more. A wedding was being held in an adjacent tent at the time; the groom was among those killed, hours before his planned celebration. Women and children were among the casualties. Hamas spokesperson Hazem Qasim condemned the strike as a 'horrific massacre of displaced civilians.' The IDF told AFP it had 'targeted terrorists in that sector' but provided no specific targeting justification. Al Jazeera reported at least 10 Palestinians were killed in multiple strikes across Gaza on June 6. The incident drew particular media attention because video footage showed the immediate aftermath of the wedding celebration interrupted by the strike. Gaza's cumulative post-ceasefire death toll continues to climb past 960+ since October 11, 2025.

title: IDF Fire Kills 7-Month-Old Baby in Hebron (Tel Rumeida); Parents Wounded
detail: Israeli troops shot and killed Sam Fahd Abu Haikal, a 7-month-old Palestinian infant, in the Tel Rumeida area south of Hebron on June 6, 2026. Soldiers opened fire on the family's vehicle; the baby was struck in the face and killed. Both parents were wounded. The IDF stated that soldiers fired at a car perceived to be accelerating toward them, and that an initial inquiry concluded the three Palestinians wounded or killed were uninvolved civilians. The killing of a 7-month-old drew immediate international condemnation and widespread media coverage. The incident occurred in H2 Hebron — an area under Israeli military control where approximately 500 settlers live among 30,000 Palestinians, and where checkpoint shootings have been documented repeatedly.

title: Settler Rampage in Huwara: 9 Palestinians Wounded, IDF Soldier Filmed Beating Palestinians Alongside Settlers
detail: Israeli settlers attacked Huwara, south of Nablus in the West Bank, on June 6, 2026, wounding nine Palestinians. Surveillance footage captured an IDF soldier in full military gear beating two Palestinian men alongside settlers — a documented instance of IDF troops joining rather than restraining settler violence. The IDF said the soldier's actions were 'serious and inconsistent with IDF values' and that the soldier would face disciplinary proceedings. The Huwara attack is the latest in an uninterrupted pattern of West Bank settler violence documented throughout 2026, occurring the day after settlers attacked the village of Idhna in the Hebron governorate. IDF Central Command Chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth warned on May 1 that settler violence constitutes 'Jewish terror' — yet videos of soldiers participating in the violence continue to emerge.

title: Hamas Delegation Arrives in Cairo for Ceasefire Implementation Talks; Egypt Hosts New Round of Negotiations
detail: A senior Hamas delegation arrived in Cairo on June 5–6, 2026 for a new round of ceasefire implementation talks with Egyptian mediators. Qatar and Turkey joined as co-mediators. The talks focused on completing Phase 1 ceasefire implementation, re-opening border crossings, improving humanitarian aid access, international force deployment proposals, and preliminary discussions about Phase 2 disarmament proposals under Trump's Board of Peace framework. Hamas told the mediating delegations that ending Israeli assassinations and targeted killings was an essential precondition for any substantive progress. The Cairo talks follow the collapse of the El-Alamein talks on June 3 when Hamas categorically rejected weapons surrender as a precondition. This new round represents Egyptian-mediated shuttle diplomacy aimed at finding common ground on the sequence of Phase 2 steps before any formal talks on disarmament.
